Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_13466",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":257,"var":"Data","code":"size_t count = cs_disasm(handle, Data+1, Size-1, address, 0, &all_insn);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input bytes (Data+1) are passed to cs_disasm as raw X86 instruction bytes for disassembly"},
   {"step":2,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"X86_Intel_printInst",
    "line":703,"var":"MI","code":"printInstruction(MI, O);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"X86_Intel_printInst calls the auto-generated printInstruction which dispatches to printOperand for each operand"},
   {"step":3,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"printOperand",
    "line":806,"var":"access","code":"uint8_t access[6];",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Local access[6] array is declared without initialization; get_op_access only partially fills it based on the instruction's table entry (which is {0} for GF2P8AFFINEINVQB), leaving access[1..5] uninitialized"},
   {"step":4,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"get_op_access",
    "line":426,"var":"access[i]","code":"access[i] = 0;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"get_op_access copies entries from the insn_ops table and terminates with 0; for an instruction with access={0} only access[0] is set to 0"},
   {"step":5,"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"printOperand",
    "line":815,"var":"access[MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count]","code":"MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.operands[MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count].access = access[MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count];",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"When op_count>=1 (second or later operand), access[op_count] is read from the uninitialized portion of the local array, causing use-of-uninitialized-value"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
     "line":257,"operands":["Data+1"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"printOperand",
     "line":806,"operands":["access[6]","op_count"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"op_count","right":"initialized_count_of_access"}},
   "sink":{"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"printOperand",
     "line":815,"operands":["access[MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count]","MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count"],
     "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count","right":"initialized_count_of_access"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasm.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":257,"operands":["Data+1"]},
      "to":{"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"X86_Intel_printInst",
       "line":703,"operands":["MI"]},
      "type":"data","via":["cs_disasm","handle"]},
     {"from":{"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"X86_Intel_printInst",
       "line":703,"operands":["MI"]},
      "to":{"file":"arch/X86/X86IntelInstPrinter.c","function":"printOperand",
       "line":815,"operands":["access[MI->flat_insn->detail->x86.op_count]"]},
      "type":"data","via":["printInstruction","MCInst_getOpcode"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
